<!-- Generated by scripts/release/docs.mjs from cli/lib/init.mjs — edit the source, then run `node scripts/release/docs.mjs sync`. -->

`agent-kit.json` holds the setup answers. Change them by re-running `agent-kit init`.

| Field | What | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | Project name (kebab-case). | folder name |
| `kind` | Setup kind: what `init` scaffolded.<br>`monorepo` — web + app + docs scaffold on Nuxt + Supabase<br>`site` — one simple Nuxt site with Markdown pages — easiest<br>`existing` — add the agent layer to this folder's code<br>`blank` — agent layer only, no template — start from nothing | asked |
| `apps` | Monorepo apps (`web`, `app`, `docs`); empty for other kinds.<br>`web` — public website (Nuxt, prerendered)<br>`app` — main solution (Nuxt SPA + BFF + Supabase)<br>`docs` — help / wiki site (Docus) | `web,app,docs` |
| `stack` | Stack conventions skill installed in `.claude/skills/`.<br>`none` — no stack conventions skill<br>`nuxt-supabase` — stack-nuxt-supabase skill (pages, BFF routes, migrations, RPCs)<br>`nuxt-content-site` — stack-nuxt-content-site skill (Markdown pages, styling, build) | from the kind |
| `technicalLevel` | How the agent talks to you.<br>`technical` — concise developer language<br>`non-technical` — plain language; the agent makes technical decisions | `technical` |
| `language` | Agent reply language.<br>`en` — English<br>`es` — Español | `en` |
| `methodology` | SDD, or SDD + TDD (tests first, enforced by preflight).<br>`sdd-tdd` — spec first, then tests before code; preflight blocks untested logic<br>`sdd` — spec first; every scenario verified by a test or a check | `sdd-tdd` |
| `commitConvention` | Conventional Commits checked by commitlint, or free-form.<br>`conventional` — type(scope): subject — checked by commitlint and a git hook<br>`none` — no message checks | `conventional` |
| `gitFlow` | What the agent may do with git (enforced by a hook).<br>`pr` — agent never commits or pushes on main<br>`trunk` — commits on main; no force-push or hard reset<br>`read-only` — agent never changes git; you run git yourself | `pr` |
| `mainBranch` | The main (production) branch: detected from git at setup (origin's HEAD, or the only main / master / trunk / production / prod branch), asked when not sure; `upgrade` re-checks that it exists. Preflight compares against it; the git guard protects it. | detected, else `main` |
| `testIgnore` | Paths without unit tests (thin route handlers). | `apps/*/server/api/` in the monorepo |
| `testCommand` | Command that runs the tests, when not the default. | — |
| `contextBudget` | Tokens per session above which `doctor` fails. | `8000` |
| `supabaseMcp` | Supabase project ref for the read-only MCP server in `.mcp.json`. | — |
| `qa.checklist` | Generate `work/qa/checklist.md` from the living specs. | `true` |
| `qa.testData` | Supabase seed / purge scripts (Supabase projects only). | `true` on Supabase |
| `qa.testPrefix` | Marker every test row starts with. | `TEST_` |
| `qa.testDataDir` | Where the test-data scripts live. | `supabase/test-data` |
| `kitVersion` | Kit version that last wrote the setup (drives the upgrade notice). | written by init |
